modules.name: Foundation & App Shell
modules.summary: Install & wire the full stack into the RN 0.75 scaffold (NativeWind, React Navigation, Zustand, Zod, RHF, eslint-plugin-boundaries); establish the design system with light+dark theming tokens; bottom-tab + native-stack navigation; splash screen; first-launch detection; offline app shell; responsive layout primitives; shared UI primitives (empty state, loading indicator) and accessibility-label conventions. Anchor module — sets the Tier-1 mechanics for every later module.
coherenceChecks: Every feature module consumes the shared theme tokens (light+dark) from src/theme — none hardcodes hex colors or rolls its own palette.
All screens are mounted through the single navigation tree in src/app/navigation — no ad-hoc navigators.
Shared UI primitives (empty state, loading indicator) live in src/components/ui and are reused, not re-implemented per feature.

modules.name: Local Persistence
modules.summary: Local-only persistence layer built on react-native-mmkv (the modern AsyncStorage replacement per OQ-1): a typed storage service, persist/restore of profile + tasks across app restarts, hydration on startup, and graceful recovery from corrupted/invalid local data (Zod-guarded reads, safe fallbacks). Anchor module — establishes the Tier-1 storage/store-hydration pattern that PRO and TSK reuse. No backend, no network.
coherenceChecks: Both Profile and Tasks persist through the single MMKV storage service — neither writes to MMKV/AsyncStorage directly or rolls its own persistence.
Every persisted read is Zod-guarded with a safe fallback, so corrupted local data never crashes startup (F-038).
Zustand stores hydrate from the storage service on startup exactly once, via the shared hydration pattern.

modules.name: Profile
modules.summary: User profile: mandatory first-launch setup (name AND email both required per OQ-2; photo optional per OQ-3), edit profile, view profile, add/change profile photo, remove profile photo, and form validation (RHF + Zod, surfacing validation errors — F-033). One profile per device, persisted locally via the STG service. First module with a form — anchors the RHF+Zod form pattern.
coherenceChecks: Profile forms use the shared RHF + Zod validation pattern (established here) — the same pattern Tasks reuse for task validation.
Profile persists only through the STG storage service; no direct MMKV access.
Mandatory-setup gating (first launch -> Profile Setup before Home) is driven by the first-launch detection from FND, not a second source of truth.

modules.name: Task Management
modules.sequencePreference: after PRO (human build-order preference; technically parallel with PRO)
modules.summary: Core task lifecycle: create, list, view details, edit, delete (with confirmation), mark completed / restore to pending, duplicate; task fields (title required, description, status, optional due date add/remove, creation + last-updated timestamps); navigation to task detail and edit; pull-to-refresh; task validation (require title F-034, prevent duplicate submission F-035). The product's core value module. Reuses the STG store pattern and the PRO form pattern.
coherenceChecks: Task validation reuses the shared RHF + Zod form pattern from PRO — it does not roll a second validation approach.
Tasks persist only through the STG storage service; the last-updated timestamp is computed in one place and reused (not recomputed per screen).
Task list/detail/edit screens all read from the single Tasks store slice — no duplicated task state.

modules.name: Search, Filter, Sort
modules.summary: Organize the task list: search by title and description with real-time (as-you-type) results; filter by All / Active / Completed; sort by due date, creation date, alphabetically, and recently updated; no-search-results empty state (F-031). Operates on the Tasks store from TSK — a derived/selector layer over the existing task data, no new persistence.
coherenceChecks: Search/filter/sort are DERIVED selectors (selectVisibleTasks) over the single Tasks store from TSK — they never copy, duplicate, or mutate/reorder the store tasks array (the store is the persistence-order source of truth).

Filter + sort are UI preferences persisted as ONE {filter,sort} envelope via the typed storage service (createPersistedValue(StorageKeys.taskQuery, taskQueryPrefsSchema, ...); absent/corrupt->default), NOT the themeStore raw-key shape and NOT task data through taskRepository; search is in-memory (resets on relaunch).

The no-search-results empty state (F-031) reuses the shared EmptyState primitive from FND (a fork is blocking); the filter control reuses SegmentedControl and the sort menu reuses ActionSheet (no bespoke re-implementations).
ORG code lives inside features/tasks (query store + selector + Home wiring) — NOT a separate features/organize slice, which would be a features->features boundary violation reading the tasks store.
OQ-8 preserved: a status toggle never forces a list re-sort under the default/creation/alpha/due sorts (only sort=updated legitimately reflects the new updatedAt).
modules.architectureNote: ORG is an orchestration grouping, not a feature folder — all ORG code lives in features/tasks. Resolved decisions (/module ORG 2026-07-12): on-Home (not a separate screen); search+filter+sort compose in one pipeline; filter+sort persist via the typed storage service as one envelope, search in-memory; default sort created-desc; sort via ActionSheet, filter via SegmentedControl. ORG-001 (anchor) done, PR #18 review.
